content_html: Absolutely amazing demo! Thank you very much for the code.

very nice diagram!,
Lets take an example that we consume several WCF services, this means that we have several types of contracts.
in a default scenraio this means that our presenter will expose at least one contract from each WCF service – so we dont have a reallt domain model that is created in one project.
I don’t see a way to create a domain model that will be used by the presentation tier and other tiers , other than creating a mapping between the two models.

What do you think?
